name: supervisor-kill

graded_by.test: worker/tests/test_supervisor.py — kill_worker SIGKILLs and reaps the worker, and answers only after the reap
harness/rigs/hung-worker.sh — a worker whose loop stops answering is killed through its supervisor, and every session in it ends terminated / worker_lost

description: A hung worker ends its sessions (phase-01; session model §11 worker_heartbeat, §13). A worker whose event loop stops answering the core's ping is dead to the core — locally a worker that cannot answer is a dead worker (decision 5.38) — so the core asks its supervisor to kill it: SIGKILL, then the reap, bounded by reap_timeout. worker_killed comes only after the reap, so the core knows the process and its target connections are gone.
